subject.title: Group chat sessions not persisted — only 1 session from 166+ messages

question: Should this be fixed narrowly in Telegram plain-group `updateLastRoute`, or by adopting a broader shared fallback for non-direct inbound sessions that omit explicit route updates?
rationale: Both paths can plausibly address part of the observed failure, but the shared fallback changes cross-channel session routing semantics while the narrow Telegram fix may leave adjacent non-direct channel gaps unresolved.

options.title: Prove and fix Telegram plain groups
options.body: Run live Telegram plain-group restart proof, then persist the group last route in the Telegram path without changing shared fallback behavior unless proof points there.

options.title: Adopt shared fallback
options.body: Make the shared recorder derive non-direct delivery context from inbound context after compatibility review across channel plugins and route metadata consumers.

options.title: Wait for live evidence
options.body: Keep this issue blocked until maintainers or a contributor provide current-main Telegram restart proof that separates transcript persistence from route metadata.

recommendation.title: Prove and fix Telegram plain groups
recommendation.body: Run live Telegram plain-group restart proof, then persist the group last route in the Telegram path without changing shared fallback behavior unless proof points there.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses the shared inbound session recorder and compatibility-sensitive route semantics that history ties most directly to this owner.
